task_instance: Given a realistic slow PySpark batch job (daily sales rollup over a ~300GB orders dataset with full-table count existence check, no column pruning or predicate pushdown, an unnecessary repartition shuffle, a sort-merge join against a tiny lookup table, a skewed groupBy, and a driver collect), optimize it by applying the skill's documented patterns and produce the optimized job plus an optimization report explaining each change.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md. Wrote input_slow_job.py (the sample slow job with the anti-patterns the skill targets), optimized_job.py (rewrite applying the patterns), and optimization_report.md (change-by-change mapping to the skill). Eight anti-patterns were addressed, each tied to a specific skill section: (1) .count() existence check -> .take(1) [Don'ts]; (2) column pruning via .select [Pattern 6]; (3) predicate pushdown of status/date filters at read [Pattern 1/6]; (4) removed .repartition(1000) full shuffle, rely on AQE coalescePartitions [Pattern 1/5]; (5) F.broadcast of the ~4MB stores table [Pattern 2]; (6) enabled AQE skewJoin for the skewed store_id groupBy [Pattern 2]; (7) removed rollup.collect(), write distributed DataFrame directly [Don'ts]; (8) full tuned session config (AQE, Kryo, memory.fraction, autoBroadcastJoinThreshold=50MB, shuffle.partitions=200) copied from the Configuration Cheat Sheet. Verification was a static code/plan review (the skill's deliverable is optimized code + config, which is text): confirmed every SKILL.md Do is present and every applicable Don't is removed, the broadcast side (4MB) is under the 50MB threshold, the .select column subset covers all later-referenced columns, and config keys match the cheat sheet verbatim. A live Spark cluster was not needed to produce the deliverable; no code was executed and no shell was used. Files: input_slow_job.py, optimized_job.py, optimization_report.md, result.json in the work directory. No cluster was available to measure wall-clock improvement, but the skill's core deliverable is the optimized job code/configuration and the optimization rationale, which were produced and reviewed statically.
